en: Color postcard showing a small wooden boat with people near a quay on a waterfront at sunset or sunrise. Buildings, piers and masts are visible along the shoreline in the background. At the top left printed bilingual text in Greek and French identifies the view of the quay in Thessaloniki/Salonique. There is a handwritten message in French across the sky area, and a modern watermark "www.elia.org.gr" at the bottom right.
